choice_data_list: What's wrong? Did you mess up?
What's wrong? Did you mess up?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, it's nothing major. To be honest, I 
got a pimple on my forehead."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"It's probably just from eating too many 
sweets, so if I cut back, it should clear 
up on its own. ...At least, that's what I 
think..........."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Sweets... How many days do I have 
to hold back for...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not being able to eat her favorite food 
seems to be taking quite a toll on her. To 
cheer her up, I decided to arrange for 
some treats that won't aggravate her skin 
irritation—
